page.layout: One page of text. Running head across the top with page number at the right. Main text in three groups: a heading line, then Principes, Duces, Marchiones and Comites sections, each with brace-grouped columns of place names (left, middle and right columns) and a label at the left. Notes in the right margin beside each section heading. Line numbers 10 to 50 in the left margin.

Comites. lvi.

page.notes: Marginal line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 in the left margin are reproduced as notes. Side notes "Principes", "Duces", "Marchiones", "Comites" are in the right margin. Brace groupings are rendered as line-by-line columns; the label "Il Principe de" and its partner labels are approximated. Some words in the scan are faint, notably "Crvita", "Monte Herculi & Francas" and "Rocca de Monte Dracone"; these may need checking. The left-margin number 10 appears as a printed mark and is reproduced as is.
